headline: Ratchet & Clank adds Kalebo III code and richer Godot exports
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 report rises from 16.96% to 19.79% matched code after level-code batches, including Kalebo III and functions adapted from the US decompilation. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Godot exports gain object models and animations alongside a coloured collision layer (rac1-decomp#21). Level 18 work also preserves closer unfinished reconstructions without counting them as exact matches.
